title: 第2706章 第三层第2705章 开门
slug: 我修天道见谁都能一招秒
content_zh:
门扉的缝隙之中，一条残破的通天大道，隐约可见。
轰隆！
就在这时，石板上的残肢断臂，越发疯狂起来。
一道道天地规则凝聚成寒芒，朝着七位逆天之子坠落而下。
天诛剑主人瞳孔一缩，拔剑横斩。
当、当、当……
他接连挡住了不知几百万道攻击之后，终于支撑不住……
噗、噗、噗……
无数寒芒，刺穿了他的身体，重创了他的生命本源。
“可恶的东西！”而在这时，那六臂血肉生灵冷哼一声，沾染了血液的六条手臂横扫而来。
砰、砰、砰……
可只是一个瞬间，他便直接损失了四条手臂。
“可恶！”他一脸惊恐的退开。
轰、轰、轰！
而在这时，那些寒芒又朝着另外几个逆天之子攻去。
只一瞬间，余下几位逆天之子，也都遭遇了重创。
不过，就在七位逆天之子，将要被彻底斩杀的时候……
轰隆！
一声巨响，那石板化作的大门，被彻底打开。
而随着门板翻转，那些被钉在门板上的残肢断臂，消失在几人眼前。

呼！
而在这时，一股苍凉古朴的气息，从大门另一头传来。
“这是什么？”
下方众人看着这一切，却全都懵了。
从他们的视角看来，七位逆天之子，先前一直在和一个看不见的对手交手。
而且，那对手的实力，明显更在逆天之子之上。
眼看着逆天之子将要坚持不住的时候，半空中却突然出现了一个空间入口。
这期间发生了什么，他们根本不清楚。
不过，就在这时，一个天衍门的长老猛然抬头，看向天空，颤声道：“这……这是大道争锋第三层？大道争锋，竟然真的存在第三层！”
“什么？大道争锋……第三层？”一个老者满脸茫然的看向他。
另一边，人群之中，灵皇看着摇摇欲坠的逆天之子，眼中忽然闪过一丝寒芒。
呼！
就见他踉跄起身，用残破的魂体，开始聚集魂力。
嗡！
content_en:
In the crack of the door, a broken avenue to the sky can be vaguely seen.
Boom!
At this moment, the broken limbs and arms on the stone slab became more and more crazy.
The rules of heaven and earth condensed into cold light and fell towards the seven sons of heaven and earth.
The master of the Heavenly Punishment Sword shrank his pupils and drew his sword to strike horizontally.
When, when, when...
After blocking millions of attacks, he finally couldn't hold on any longer...
Puff, puff, puff...
Countless cold rays pierced his body and severely damaged the origin of his life.
"Damn it!" At this moment, the six-armed flesh and blood creature snorted coldly, and the six blood-stained arms swept over.
Bang, bang, bang...
But in just an instant, he lost four arms.
"Damn it!" He backed away with a look of horror.
Boom, boom, boom!
At this moment, those cold lights were attacking the other sons of the Heaven Defying Ones.
In just an instant, the remaining Sons of Defiance also suffered heavy losses.
However, just when the seven defying sons were about to be completely killed...
Boom!
With a loud noise, the stone door was completely opened.
As the door panel flipped over, the broken limbs that were nailed to the door panel disappeared before the eyes of several people.
call!
At this moment, a desolate and primitive atmosphere came from the other side of the gate.
"What is this?"
Everyone below looked at all this, but they were all confused.
From their perspective, the seven Heaven-Defying Sons had been fighting an invisible opponent.
Moreover, the opponent's strength was obviously higher than that of the Son of Heaven.
Just when the Son of Heaven was about to lose his hold, a space entrance suddenly appeared in mid-air.
They had no idea what happened during this period.
However, at this moment, an elder from the Tianyan Sect suddenly raised his head, looked at the sky, and said in a trembling voice: "This...is this the third level of the Great Avenue of Confrontation? There really is a third level of the Great Avenue of Confrontation!"
"What? Dao Zhengzheng...the third floor?" An old man looked at him with a confused face.
On the other side, among the crowd, the Spirit Emperor looked at the crumbling Son of Heaven, and a cold light suddenly flashed in his eyes.
call!
He stumbled to his feet and began to gather soul power with his broken soul body.
Buzz!
